title: Verification you can understand.
description: Confirm your contact details, see what each check means, and send evidence when you are ready.

basic.title: Basic verification
basic.lead: Contact checks support account integrity. They do not verify skills, identity, education, or employment.

phone.label: Phone number
phone.numberHint: Your number, with or without the country code.
phone.resendIn: Send a new code in {{count}} s
phone.codeShown: Your code is {{code}}. Enter it below within {{minutes}} minutes.
phone.codeNote: We show the code here instead of sending a text message.

checks.title: Profile verification
checks.lead: An administrator reviews each check. Recruiters see a tick for every approved one.
checks.bannerLead: Identity is always needed. Education and employment checks are needed when your profile lists them.

identity.label: Identity
identity.description: Government-issued photo ID reviewed against the account holder’s details.
identity.accepted: Accepted evidence: passport, driving licence or national identity card.

academic.label: Academic qualifications
academic.description: Qualification evidence reviewed against an education entry on your profile.
academic.accepted: Accepted evidence: degree certificate, diploma or official transcript.
academic.notNeeded: Needed once your profile lists education.

employment.label: Employment documents
employment.description: Employment evidence reviewed against a role on your profile.
employment.accepted: Accepted evidence: employment letter, contract page or verified reference.
employment.notNeeded: Needed once your profile lists work history.

rightToWork.title: Right to work
rightToWork.lead: Optional: evidence for a right-to-work entry, reviewed by an administrator.
rightToWork.empty: Add your right to work on My profile first.

certificates.title: External certificates
certificates.lead: Optional: ask an administrator to review a certificate file. Recruiters see “Verified” only for reviewed certificates.
certificates.empty: Add certificates on My profile first.
certificates.noFile: Add a file to this certificate on My profile to request a review.

dialog.title: Submit evidence: {{check}}
dialog.description: An administrator reviews the file against your profile. Evidence files are deleted 30 days after the decision.
dialog.confirm: This evidence is mine and accurate.

badge.title: What a badge means
badge.text: A badge represents only the checks named beside it. It is not an endorsement, hiring recommendation, or guarantee that profile claims are accurate.
